title: Renew or restore a property certificate of registration (Restricted to Livestock only)
summary: This page provides information on renewing or restoring a property certificate of registration restricted to livestock activities.
intro: The restricted certificate allows the holder to carry out livestock-related activities. This certificate was only made available to holders of a stock and station certificate of registration immediately before 23 March 2020 and is no longer being offered.
who_can_apply: You must be an assistant stock and station agent with a certificate of registration restricted to livestock-related activities.
what_you_need: Your renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice), or your full personal details
To apply for renewal online, you need to follow the online prompts.

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to complete your renewal.
To pay at a service centre check the payment options available.
Some service centres do not accept cash payments.

more_info.text: Visit the NSW Fair Trading website for more information on Working as an agent in the real estate and property industry.

external_links.text: Working as an agent in the real estate and property industry

internal_links.text: Replace a property certificate of registration

faqs.q: Who can renew or restore this certificate?
faqs.a: You can renew or restore your certificate if you are an assistant stock and station agent with a certificate of registration restricted to livestock-related activities.

faqs.q: What happens if my certificate has expired?
faqs.a: If your certificate has expired, you can apply online to restore your licence within 3 months of the certificate expiry date, and you will need to pay the restoration fee.

faqs.q: How do I renew my certificate online?
faqs.a: Select the 'Renew online' button and follow the prompts to complete your renewal.
